final_proof:
Let
\[
\Phi_{X,L}:\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf{Loc}}(\mathbf\Omega X,L)
\longrightarrow
\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf{Top}}(X,\operatorname{Sp}L)
\]
be the natural family of bijections defining the spectrum adjunction \(\mathbf\Omega\dashv\operatorname{Sp}\). Thus, for a continuous map \(u:X'\to X\), a locale morphism \(h:\mathbf\Omega X\to L\), and a locale morphism \(v:L\to M\), naturality of the adjunction bijection gives
\[
\Phi_{X',L}(h\circ\mathbf\Omega u)=\Phi_{X,L}(h)\circ u \tag{1}
\]
and
\[
\Phi_{X,M}(v\circ h)=\operatorname{Sp}(v)\circ\Phi_{X,L}(h). \tag{2}
\]

The component of the counit at a locale \(L\) is, by its construction from the adjunction bijection, the unique locale morphism
\[
\sigma_L:\mathbf\Omega\operatorname{Sp}L\longrightarrow L
\]
such that
\[
\Phi_{\operatorname{Sp}L,L}(\sigma_L)
=\operatorname{id}_{\operatorname{Sp}L}. \tag{3}
\]

Let \(f:L\to M\) be any locale morphism. We must prove
\[
f\circ\sigma_L
=\sigma_M\circ\mathbf\Omega\operatorname{Sp}(f), \tag{4}
\]
where both sides are morphisms \(\mathbf\Omega\operatorname{Sp}L\to M\). Apply the bijection \(\Phi_{\operatorname{Sp}L,M}\). By (2) and (3),
\[
\Phi_{\operatorname{Sp}L,M}(f\circ\sigma_L)
=\operatorname{Sp}(f)\circ\Phi_{\operatorname{Sp}L,L}(\sigma_L)
=\operatorname{Sp}(f).
\]
On the other hand, apply (1) with \(X=\operatorname{Sp}M\), \(X'=\operatorname{Sp}L\), \(u=\operatorname{Sp}(f)\), and \(h=\sigma_M\). Using (3) for \(M\), we obtain
\[
\begin{aligned}
\Phi_{\operatorname{Sp}L,M}
 (\sigma_M\circ\mathbf\Omega\operatorname{Sp}(f))
&=\Phi_{\operatorname{Sp}M,M}(\sigma_M)\circ\operatorname{Sp}(f)\\
&=\operatorname{id}_{\operatorname{Sp}M}\circ\operatorname{Sp}(f)\\
&=\operatorname{Sp}(f).
\end{aligned}
\]
Thus the two sides of (4) have the same image under the injective map \(\Phi_{\operatorname{Sp}L,M}\), and hence they are equal. Since \(f\) was arbitrary,
\[
f\circ\sigma_L
=\sigma_M\circ\mathbf\Omega\operatorname{Sp}(f)
\]
for every locale morphism \(f:L\to M\). This is precisely the naturality condition, so
\[
\sigma:\mathbf\Omega\operatorname{Sp}\Rightarrow
\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf{Loc}}
\]
is a natural transformation.
